sentences.text: S1 stated that disclosures of harm or abuse would be reported to others to keep the person safe, and S2 agreed this was understood.
S2 reported that he does catering on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, where they made pizzas last week.
S2 reported that he volunteers at the garden centre on Fridays, doing watering and trolleys.
S2 reported that he sometimes cooks at the flat, but staff help him with the oven; he can do pasta on his own.
S2 reported that Sandra is the best staff member and Priya is nice.
S2 reported that he gets up for a drink at night.
S2 expressed a wish to go to Blackpool for a holiday.
S1 stated that S2's holiday would be looked at regarding money.
S2 reported that Craig pushed him into the wall in the hall outside the kitchen.
S2 reported that Craig pushed him into the wall and that his shoulder hit the wall, causing some hurt.
S2 reported that the incident where Craig pushed him into the wall happened last week, specifically on a Thursday night before the garden centre shift.
S2 reported that Craig kicked him on the back of his leg three times.
S2 reported that Craig kicked him on the back of his leg and that it hurt, resulting in a bruise.
S2 reported that Craig told him not to tell anyone and that if he told, he would lose his flat.
S2 stated that he did not want to lose his flat.
S1 promised that Jamie would not lose his flat because he told the social worker.
S2 reported that Marcus told him that Craig hit Sophie, but S2 did not see this himself as he was in his room.
S2 reported that Craig got cross when S2 got up for a drink at night, and Craig told S2 to go back to bed.
S2 reported that Craig told him he would lose his flat if he told anyone about the incidents.
S2 stated that Marcus told him Craig hit Sophie, but S2 did not see it himself.
S2 reported that Sandra helps him with money, he gets money on a Monday, and he does a list.
S2 reported that he sees his mum on Sundays, where she picks him up and they go to Nan's for dinner.
S2 reported that Craig works the nights, mostly.
S2 reported that Craig is alright, sometimes.
S1 agreed to report the disclosures to the safeguarding team at the council, ring Sandra, and ask that Craig does not work at night while it is looked into.
S1 agreed to ring S2's mum this afternoon.
S1 agreed to bring easy-read information about safeguarding to S2.
S1 agreed to return on Tuesday the 1st of December at 4 o'clock after college to check on S2.
